points: GitHub Changelog confirms CRUD endpoints at repository, organization and enterprise levels.

G2 read both pages: official endpoint/reference pages dominate page one; page two adds a detailed as-code guide, GitHub's public example repository, videos, push-protection endpoints and community discussions.

G3 veto: GitHub REST Docs provides complete parameters, permissions and executable request samples; the public advanced-security repository provides 591 commits of free custom-pattern examples. Both persistently visible resources complete implementation work.
